title: Passkeys in Action | FIDO Alliance Demo Video
summary: A FIDO Alliance demo with Google and Microsoft engineers showing passkeys working across operating systems, browsers, and devices. It walks through registering and signing in on new devices.
why: HN points to it to explain how passkeys work across ecosystems and are not proprietary.

quote.text: This video[1] by the FIDO alliance shows what that process will look like with a bunch of different OS and browser combos.
